summary: Design-only resolution plan for the discrepancies between the canonical Faction and Element axes used across (a) the live roster /api/heroes, (b) the Boss Family x Element/Faction Resistance Matrix (RM1.34-B), (c) the Affinity Phase 2 gift catalog draft (AF2-A), and (d) the Collection Synergies V2 readiness draft (CS2-A). Resolution preserves the live roster as the runtime-facing source of truth, introduces an alias map for in-flight catalog reads, and freezes any Faction/Element-axis runtime ON until validator-asserted axis equality or alias coverage is confirmed.

discrepancies.impact: Direct lookups by element key (e.g. boss matrix row) will fail when keyed against roster heroes (`dark`).
`tides` exists as a boss matrix faction group but has zero live heroes; minting affinity gifts or collection synergies for `tides` would create orphan records.

canonical_element_recommendation.treatment_of_legacy_token_darkness: alias to dark for catalog read-throughs; do not mutate RM1.34-B source in this task; flag for a future controlled patch task (RM1.34-B-PATCH).
canonical_element_recommendation.ui_localization_preserved: Oscurita / Darkness (display only) maps to canonical_token=dark

canonical_faction_recommendation.tides_status: design_pending; not live until live roster source confirms at least one tides hero or tides is officially struck from RM1.34-B; affinity / collection synergy must NOT mint records for tides today.

alias_map.policy: alias map is consumed only by inert read-through resolvers; battle_engine.py and combat.tsx MUST NOT import it directly until activation gate passes.

activation_gate.name: faction_element_axis_activation_gate
required_before_any_runtime_on: validator MUST assert that, for every faction/element used by an activating runtime, either (a) the token equals a live roster token exactly, OR (b) the token is in alias_map and the alias target is a live roster token.
validator MUST assert that no orphan faction (e.g. `tides`) has runtime records emitted.
validator MUST assert RM1.34-B downstream consumers (collection synergies, affinity gifts, divine weapons, boss policies) read through the alias map and not via direct token equality.
Borea hidden-state invariant MUST hold (`greek_borea` catalog-only, `borea` / `primordial_gaia` 404).

risk_notes: If runtime were activated today without alias coverage, boss element-resistance lookups against live heroes with element=`dark` would silently miss the `darkness` matrix row, producing zero-resistance defaults that could swing PvP balance.
If affinity / collection synergy were to mint records for `tides` based on RM1.34-B, players would see orphan entries that can never progress, eroding trust.

Mutating RM1.34-B source in this task (changing `darkness` -> `dark` or dropping `tides`) would invalidate the boss balance review and is FORBIDDEN by safety rules; we resolve via alias map + design plan, not by source patch.

recommended_next_patches_future_only.scope: Migrate RM1.34-B element token `darkness` -> `dark` in a controlled patch task with re-baseline.
recommended_next_patches_future_only.blocked_until: boss balance review re-ratifies the matrix under canonical token `dark`.

recommended_next_patches_future_only.scope: Resolve `tides` faction: either officially add at least one live `tides` hero (roster patch) or strike `tides` from the matrix.
Confirm AF2-A gift draft canonical adoption of `dark` (already adopted) and explicit non-mint of `tides_*` entries (already non-minted).
